_note: Nebius Token Factory settings. IDs confirmed via GET /models (2026-10-21); prices, tok/s and processing regions from the Token Factory console public-endpoint cards (2026-10-22). Public endpoints can change region and price at any time - re-check before the README cost numbers. The base URL can be overridden on the options page; model choice is config-only (taskModels).
_modelsNote: Which model each feature uses is set in taskModels; name is shown on the options page. Order: smallest first.
_taskModelsNote: Which Nemotron each feature uses (a key of models; default lightning). evaluate -> ultra, chosen from bench/results 2026-10-22: Ultra reasoning-off 9/10 cases, 0.8 s, ~$0.0016/call vs Lightning 4/10, 7.1 s. research -> super, chosen from bench/results 2026-10-27 (11 claude.ai models, agent mode): Super and Ultra 10/10 prices agree, Nano 9/10, Lightning 10/10 as agent but 8/10 as pipeline; Super 1.5 Tavily credits, 3.8 s, ~$0.0023 per model vs Ultra 2.4 credits, 7.5 s, ~$0.013.
_researchNote: Model research agent (Nemotron + Tavily tools). maxToolCalls caps Tavily calls per model; recheckDays re-researches done models; retryHours retries failed ones.
_dedicatedNote: Dedicated endpoints (not used): $2.00-$9.70 per GPU hour (L40S $2.00, H100 $4.70, H200 $5.60, B200 $8.70, B300 $9.70; eu-north1, console 2026-10-22). One H100 24/7 is about $3,400/month.
_reasoningOffNote: bench probe 2026-10-22: chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false gives 0 reasoning on Nano/Lightning/Super/Ultra; a '/no_think' system prefix has no effect (same reasoning as no switch). Reasoning is ON by default.
_jsonModeNote: Sends response_format {type: json_object}. Set to false if Token Factory returns HTTP 400 for it; the JSON is still validated either way.
_streamNote: 2026-10-21: non-streaming Lightning calls hung >30s while streaming answered in ~8s. Not reproduced in the 2026-10-22 bench probe (non-stream fine on all 4 Nemotron models). Kept on: it also gives time-to-first-token.
